# secureaccess_private_resource_group (Resource)

This resource manages a Private Resource Group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "secureaccess_private_resource_group" "example" {
  name                 = "my private resource group"
  description          = "This is my private resource group"
  private_resource_ids = [123456]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Private Resource Group. The name must not have any special characters other than spaces and hyphens.
- `private_resource_ids` (Set of Number) The list of IDs of the Private Resources that belong to the group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the Private Resource Group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import secureaccess_private_resource_group.example "<id>"
```
